tools.name: list_feeds
tools.description: Free. List all Event Intel feeds with topics, current data_revision and price ($0.01 per paid call). Start here.

tools.name: get_coverage
tools.description: Free. Coverage of one feed: data_revision, fact count and freshness per topic, no fact contents. Poll this and call the paid get_<feed>_intel tool only when data_revision changed.

tools.name: get_gta6_intel
tools.description: GTA VI (GTA 6, Grand Theft Auto VI) launch tracker and video game news by Rockstar Games. Use when you need what Rockstar, platforms or major outlets reported in the last hours: release date, unlock times by region, preload, server status and outages, patches, known issues, editions, pricing. Each report names who said it, with link and check time. $0.01 per call in USDC on Base via x402. Poll get_coverage {"feed":"gta6"} for free and pay only when data_revision changed. Invalid input, missing data and empty topics are free.
